title: Wire EDM Deep AI Reasoning — CAD, Workholding, Setup, Parameters

units.title: CAD/Drawing AI domains
units.details: Added 3 CAD domains: wedm_cad_analysis (geometry manufacturability), wedm_feature_recognition (punch/die/slug classification), wedm_drawing_interpretation (GD&T and spec extraction)

units.title: Workholding AI domains
units.details: Added 3 workholding domains: wedm_workholding (EDM-compatible fixturing), wedm_fixturing (3R/Erowa systems, dielectric-safe materials), wedm_clamping_strategy (force, location, thin-section support)

units.title: Setup & Job Planning AI domains
units.details: Added 3 setup domains: wedm_setup_sequence (wire threading, datum pickup), wedm_machine_prep (dielectric, guides, calibration), wedm_job_planning (consumables, cycle time, quality gates)

units.title: Advanced Parameter AI domains
units.details: Added 3 advanced domains: wedm_adaptive_parameters (bi-material, thickness transitions), wedm_corner_strategy (feed reduction, arc reversal, wire deflection), wedm_thin_section (tension, energy, tab strategy)

units.title: Deep domains tribal synthesis integration
units.details: Added all 12 deep domains to manufacturingDomains array for tribal knowledge injection during AI reasoning

units.title: WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine deep AI integration
units.details: Extended collectAIRecommendations() with conditional deep AI calls: CAD analysis when profiles provided, corner strategy when tight radii, thin section when thickness <5mm. Extended ai_recommendations interface with 12 new fields. Enhanced synthesis report with deep AI summaries.

units.title: WEDM deep AI test suite
units.details: 23 tests covering: CAD/drawing domains (3), workholding domains (3), setup/job planning domains (3), advanced parameter domains (3), orchestration integration (7), synthesis report (1), tribal synthesis (3)

cad_drawing: wedm_cad_analysis — geometry manufacturability, corner radii, slug management
wedm_drawing_interpretation — GD&T, tolerances, surface integrity notes
workholding: wedm_workholding — magnetic vs mechanical, pallet systems, submerged setup
wedm_fixturing — dielectric-safe materials, quick-change, precision repeatability
wedm_clamping_strategy — force, location, thin-section support, pre-stress relief
setup_planning: wedm_setup_sequence — wire threading, datum pickup, offset verification
wedm_machine_prep — dielectric, guides, chiller, AWT test
wedm_job_planning — consumables, cycle time, quality gates, risk assessment
advanced_parameters: wedm_adaptive_parameters — bi-material zones, entry/exit, arc detection
wedm_corner_strategy — feed reduction, arc reversal, wire deflection compensation
wedm_thin_section — tension reduction, flushing pressure, support tabs

integration_points.PRISMIntelligenceLayer: 12 deep domains + prompts + tribal synthesis injection
integration_points.WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine: Conditional AI collection based on input: profiles→CAD, tight radii→corners, thin→thin_section

summary: Deep AI hardening for Wire EDM covering full manufacturing workflow. 12 new domains: CAD analysis (geometry, features, drawings), workholding (fixturing, clamping), setup (sequence, prep, planning), and advanced parameters (adaptive, corners, thin sections). All domains integrated into WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine with conditional activation. Tribal knowledge injected for all domains. 23 tests + prior 21 = 44 total WEDM AI tests.
